name: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management
summary: Private finance and business school on a Frankfurt city campus; four English-taught BSc degrees with a semester abroad, entry by online assessment.

ib.text: IB Diploma accepted; no points minimum and no numerus clausus. You are admitted on an online assessment centre: maths, cognitive and English tests and an interview. No English certificate is needed.

dates.label: Assessment centre dates offered so far: 21 Oct, 18 Nov, 10 Dec 2026 (apply 2 weeks before)
Application deadline, all four full-time bachelor's

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Administration
programmes.about: A broad business degree over seven semesters: start in English or German (all teaching is in English from semester 4), pick two of nine specialisations, and spend semester 5 abroad with an internship.
programmes.ib: Taught in English or German; choose the English track (the German track switches to English from semester 4).
programmes.selectionNote: No NC: an online assessment centre (maths, cognitive and English tests plus a structured interview) and your motivation decide. No weights or places published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering
programmes.about: Maths, computer science and machine learning taught in English and applied to business problems, ending in a capstone project, with a semester abroad at one of 150 partner universities in year 3.
programmes.ib: No school subject is required, but the school says you need a strong maths foundation; maths is one of the assessment-centre tests. Programming is not required.
programmes.selectionNote: No NC: an online assessment centre (maths, cognitive and English tests plus a structured interview) and your motivation decide. Places are limited but not published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management, Philosophy & Economics
programmes.about: Management, economics and philosophy studied side by side in English, partly in small-group supervisions, with a semester abroad and an internship in year 3 and a concentration at the end.
programmes.ib: No philosophy, economics or business needed from school.
programmes.selectionNote: No NC: an online assessment centre (maths, cognitive and English tests plus a structured interview) and your motivation decide. No weights or places published.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Information Systems Engineering
programmes.about: Business informatics in English (programming, algorithms, databases, AI, finance) on a three-day study model, so you can work alongside your studies at a partner firm or a company you choose.
programmes.ib: Working with a partner company (such as Deutsche Bank or KfW, which pay part of tuition) needs German; a company of your own choice does not.
programmes.selectionNote: No NC: an online assessment centre (maths, cognitive and English tests plus a structured interview) and your motivation decide. Partner firms run their own hiring.

notes: Admission is rolling: you can apply with your last two school reports instead of the final diploma, and must apply at least two weeks before your assessment-centre date.
On top of tuition you pay a €100 application fee and a €600 enrolment fee.
Every programme runs seven semesters, with semester 5 spent studying abroad at a partner university and doing an internship.
